note: bobby-only gauntlet baseline, measured on main at 2e48fbf6 after the Phase 18 measurement batch (2026-09-10: 5/5 pass, 0 tool errors, mean 484K cache-read / 35K cache-create / 9.8 calls, claude-opus-5, chromium/off, results/phase18-opus). score check evaluates only the latest invocation batch and requires every baseline task; pass must hold, wall time <= 2x, tool errors <= +3, and (with --runs N) every run must pass while the mean faces the thresholds. The budget block caps mean per-task token/call economics — the PRD's 'call economics measurable but not enforced' gap — with ~40% headroom over the measured 480K cache-read / 32K cache-create / 9.6 calls (claude-opus-5, 2026-09-01). Thresholds split by engine and provider mode via an optional top-level "dimensions" map keyed on "<engine>/<providerMode>" from the batch's provenance (e.g. "firefox/off"); a batch with no matching dimension falls back to the top-level tasks/budget, so the default cell is not duplicated. Update deliberately when the product improves or the app changes; never to sneak a regression through.
